newsitem.title: UK: Croatian Development Bank plans 700 mln ATS bond.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Development Bank plans 700 mln ATS bond.

text.p: The Croatian Development Bank plans to launch a 700 million Austrian shilling five-year Eurobond by the end of April, lead manager Creditanstalt-Bankverein said on Wednesday.
"This is going to be a very interesting deal because it is the first bond issue ever they have done, including in their domestic market," a syndicate official at CABV told Reuters.
The deal will be guaranteed by Croatia which is rated Baa3 by Moody's Investors Service and BBB- by Standard and Poor's Corp.
"They see the (Austrian) shilling as their enlarged home market and Croatia is popular in Austria which is why they decided to go for the currency," the CABV syndicate official said.
He said the launch spread would be around 80 basis points over comparable Austrian government bonds.
The bonds will be listed in Luxembourg and Vienna.
"We are targeting this deal at investors in Austria but we are expecting foreign demand as well," he said.
Croatia launched a $300 million five-year Eurobond in early February which was priced to yield 80 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
Dealers said the spread briefly widened out to 130 b.p. over but was tightening up again and was expected to continue to do so.
